name: compile
title: Understand a request
description: Fits when the user wants a list or table from the live web, every match or as many as asked, with the same facts on each row, also when a web search returned only part of the list: companies and local businesses, products and stores, jobs, papers, clinical trials, grants, tenders, datasets, repositories and packages, apps, books or podcasts. Not for one fact or a quick answer, which the fast web search gives, or for the text of known pages. A list the user already has is imported first, and its quote takes this reading. Reads the request in everyday words in any language. Returns how SpecStream understood it: what to find, the conditions for every result, the facts to bring back (required or optional), how many, and in what order. The returned ast_hash identifies this reading. For a list the user has, parent_find_id and the operation add facts to it, extend it or refresh it. In that case, what it finds and its conditions stay the same, and only the new facts or the new count are read. The caller needs read access to that list. Nothing runs and nothing is charged.

name: search_web
title: Search the web
description: Fits when the user asks for one fact or a quick answer from the live web, or wants the first rows of a list before the full table is priced. Not for the text of known pages. Fast search: answers in seconds. Returns kind (fact or list), the answer with the page it was read from, rows with each result's name and the facts the request asks for, each value with its page, the search results read (sources), took_ms and request_id. num (1 to 100) sets how many sources come back and page (1 to 10) continues the same list; next_page names the next page. For a list, handoff names the estimated rows and the next steps, a compiled request and a quote for the full table. like: pages to get more of (up to 20 addresses; the pages most similar to them come first, and q may then be empty). unlike: pages to leave out (up to 20). A call of up to 10 results takes $0.005 from the account's balance; each started block of 10 more results adds $0.006. With speed=fast a call takes $0.001 and a block $0.0012. It needs no quote or approval. A full list is run from a compiled request and its quote, not from this search.

q.description: The question or the request in everyday words, in any language. site:, -site:, -word, -"phrase", filetype:, after: and before: (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD) hold on every result: a result that breaks one is left out, and when that leaves a page short, the engines' next pages are searched first. Required quoted phrases ("phrase", outside OR groups) also hold strictly when page text is read (passages=true or compact=true): a read page whose read text, title and snippet lack a required phrase is left out, while an unread page stays ranked below the sources that hold the phrases. Without passages=true or compact=true, no page is read, nothing is left out for missing a phrase in an engine snippet, and results that hold more phrases come first. When no source holds a required phrase or OR group, or a bare host fallback drops site:, the reply keeps loose results and names each relaxed operator in relaxed.

A call of up to 10 results is $0.005; each started block of 10 more results adds $0.006 (100 results are $0.059). On the fast tier (speed=fast) a call of up to 10 results is $0.001 and each started block of 10 more adds $0.0012 (100 results are $0.0118).
